newsitem.title: USA: Grand Coulee 600 MW hydropower turbine off-line.
newsitem.headline: Grand Coulee 600 MW hydropower turbine off-line.

text.p: A 600 megawatt (MW) power turbine at the Grand Coulee dam in Washington state was taken off-line earlier this week for unplanned repairs, a spokesman for the U.S. Bureau of Reclamation, which operates the project, said Wednesday.
There was no final schedule for when it would restart, although the operator hoped to complete repairs on Thursday.
Meanwhile, a 700 MW at Grand Coulee remained off-line for planned maintenance scheduled to finish in December and a 125 MW at the dam was expected to resume operations sometime later this month.
Grand Coulee, the uppermost U.S. hydroelectric project on the Columbia River, has a total rated capacity of 6,150 MW.
